stem: 2. Identify the following sets as finite or infinite.
tamilStatus: pending source transcription and independent Tamil editorial review

entries.question: X = The set of all districts in Tamilnadu.
steps: The districts form an administratively enumerated list.
At a given time, the number of districts is a whole-number count, not infinitely many.
Therefore X is a finite set.

entries.question: Y = The set of all straight lines passing through a point.
steps: Fix a point P in the plane.
For every direction angle θ in [0°,180°), exactly one distinct straight line passes through P.
The interval contains infinitely many direction angles, so Y is infinite.

entries.question: A = { x : x ∈ Z and x <5}
steps: The integer condition allows all negative integers.
For every integer k < 5, k − 1 is a different integer still less than 5.
There is no smallest integer, so A has infinitely many elements.

entries.question: B = { x : x2–5x+6 = 0, x ∈ N }
steps: Interpret x2 as x² and factor x² − 5x + 6 = (x − 2)(x − 3).
The zero-product property gives x = 2 or x = 3, both natural numbers.
Thus B = {2, 3} has exactly two elements.
